title: Return Inspection Labor Standard for PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Return Inspection Labor Standard — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Standard.** When a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit bought outright comes back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request, the reconditioning labor booked for it is the standard return inspection of **2 labor units**. A labor unit is 15 minutes, and labor is booked as a whole number of units.

**Worked example (hypothetical unit).** A CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) bought outright is received back by the branch. Its return inspection books the standard return inspection: 2 labor units, or 30 minutes of reconditioning labor.

**Points of judgement.**
- *Is labor ever booked in part units?* No; labor is booked in whole 15-minute units.
- *Does the class of the device change the standard inspection?* No; the standard return inspection is 2 labor units for every PAP Therapy Equipment class.
